fusions.name: Rot in the Timbers
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 11 damage and leaves the target [Diseased] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Dry Rot Takes Hold
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt into the first enemy it meets that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, adding 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Caulked with Mycelium
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 5%.

fusions.name: Spreading Through the Hold
fusions.desc: Every hit you land adds a stack to the target, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
